story_type: missile defense intercept test, target air-dropped from a C-17
hook: A cargo jet dropped a ballistic missile. Guam shot it down.
narration: This interceptor lifted off Guam to kill a ballistic missile target in flight.
The target came from a C-17 cargo jet, flying out over the open ocean.
It fell out the back under parachutes.
Then its rocket motor lit, and it climbed like a medium range ballistic missile.
Guam's new AN/TPY-6 radar locked on shortly after launch and tracked it all the way.
The Standard Missile-3 Block IIA is hit-to-kill. It rams the target, and the force of the impact destroys it.
[short pause] It was the first ballistic missile defense test ever fired from Guam.
outcome: The Block IIA intercepted the target off the coast of Andersen Air Force Base.
title: Cargo jet drops a missile, Guam hits it
description:
The Missile Defense Agency's Flight Experiment Mission-02: an air-launched medium range ballistic missile target, dropped from a C-17, is intercepted by a Standard Missile-3 Block IIA fired from Guam, Dec. 10, 2024.
